'Day-Care' exists as map-name + script text, so the feature is likely script-driven (possibly storing via the PC system). Verify with a live A/B dump (deposit a mon, diff saveblocks)

achievements_chievos.note: UI: start-menu item 11 ('Chievos', callback 0x081B80B8) -> scenes 0x52/0x54/0x56 of the custom 'Smsh' script VM (magic 0x68736D53, scene table ROM 0x08B7EC90). Storage: real-save-vs-newgame diff of all unmapped regions leaves ONE strong candidate - SB1+0xD2C..0xD45 (>=24 bytes): all 0xFF on the 9h real save vs all 0x00 on a never-opened new game (0xFF-initialized on first use; 0xFF likely = 'locked/not earned', so the user may simply have zero achievements). Secondary candidates: SB1+0x2178 (u16[16] with 2-bit state in low bits, reset fn @0x080EA264) and the small struct at SB1+0x1280. Definitive answer needs a dump after EARNING one achievement
